_readme: Global promotions shown on every site (home page promo strip and the specials page). Edit here, commit, and all six sites redeploy. Set active:false to hide. Fields: label = short heading, text = one sentence, cta/href = button, endsOn = YYYY-MM-DD or null, icon = tag | truck | pool | sauna. heroByFocus: per-store hero variants selected by each location's homeFocus (hot-tub | sauna | swim-spa).
